title: Budding Amethyst Crafting
description: Craft Budding Amethyst blocks to grow amethyst wherever you want. Expensive recipe to better match rarity.
body:
## Craft Budding Amethyst blocks!
Now you can place them for decoration or more efficient farming.
The recipe includes a full diamond block to craft these otherwise unobtainable blocks.

_Note: Like Vanilla, you will NOT be able to obtain the placed blocks!_
If you mine them up, they will not drop anything. This pack makes them craftable to replace broken ones or to place wherever you wish instead of relying on random geode locations.

### Also includes Unpackable Amethyst blocks!
One amethyst block crafts into 4 amethyst shards, equaling the same amount used to craft the amethyst block in vanilla.


Why a diamond block in Budding Amethyst the recipe?
When considering the balance of the crafting ingredients, I try to keep several play-styles in mind. I wanted something that with a little bit of grind can be obtainable by most play-styles.

Long-term survival players may find this recipe easy to make, while more casual or newer players will need to grind a bit for the resources. All the ingredients are available in the overworld for those who don't use the nether or end dimensions.
